## MATH 476 — Statistics {.major}

Welcome to **MATH 476**.

This course introduces probability and statistics with an emphasis on
modeling and data and not running over the margins.

## Basic Probability Notation {.major}

- Sample space: $\Omega$
- Event: $A \subseteq \Omega$
- Probability of $A$: $\Prob(A)$
- Complement: $A^{c}$
- Conditional probability:
  $$
    \Prob(A \mid B) = \frac{\Prob(A \cap B)}{\Prob(B)}, \qquad \Prob(B) > 0
  $$
- Expectation $\Ex[Y]=$

[Key idea: probabilities are always between $0$ and $1$.]{.alert}
